Positioning

A technical SEO consultant with a data and analytics background.

I started in finance and accounting, then moved into process automation, data engineering, analytics, and growth. That background shapes the way I approach SEO: I do not only look at keywords. I look at systems, data flows, user behavior, technical constraints, and business outcomes.

My SEO work combines technical audits, HTML/CSS/JavaScript analysis, analytics review, content structure, page experience, and AI visibility strategy.

Visibility blockers

Your content may be good, but still technically invisible.

Many websites underperform because search engines and AI systems cannot clearly crawl, understand, connect, or trust the content. I find the gaps and turn them into a prioritized roadmap.

Important pages are not indexable or easy to discover
Internal links are weak, missing, or disconnected from key pages
Pages load slowly because of render-blocking CSS, JavaScript, images, or third-party scripts
Duplicate titles, missing metadata, or unclear heading structures reduce relevance
JavaScript-rendered content creates crawl and rendering uncertainty
Structured data is missing, invalid, or disconnected from visible content
Content does not answer buyer questions clearly enough for AI-powered search
Analytics gaps make it difficult to understand what users do after landing

AI visibility

AI visibility starts with technical clarity.

AI search does not remove the need for SEO. It increases the need for clean structure, useful content, clear entities, trustworthy signals, and technically accessible pages.

For a website to appear in AI-powered search experiences, it needs to be easy to crawl, easy to understand, and easy to summarize. My audits focus on whether your website can be discovered, interpreted, cited, and connected across a full search journey.

Entity clarity

Make the business and offer easy to understand.

Answer readiness

Answer the questions buyers actually ask.

Structure content so users, search engines, and AI systems can extract direct answers without guessing.

FAQ

Common questions about technical SEO and AI visibility.

What is included in a technical SEO audit?

A technical SEO audit reviews whether your website can be crawled, rendered, indexed, understood, and used effectively by search engines. It can include site architecture, internal linking, page speed, Core Web Vitals, metadata, structured data, canonicals, redirects, JavaScript rendering, and duplicate content.

What is AI visibility?

AI visibility is the ability of your brand, content, and website to appear, be cited, or be summarized in AI-powered search experiences, including answer engines, conversational search, Google AI features, and AI assistants that use web search.

Is AEO/GEO different from traditional SEO?

Yes and no. The technical foundation is similar: your content still needs to be crawlable, indexable, trustworthy, and useful. The difference is that AI-powered search often works through conversational questions, summaries, citations, and multi-step user journeys.

Do you implement fixes or only provide audits?

I can provide audits, implementation guidance, QA, and ongoing support. For development-heavy changes, I can work with your developer or team and provide clear technical recommendations.

Can you work with clients in the US and Canada?

Yes. I work remotely with clients in the US, Canada, and globally. También hablo español.
